brainlife.desc: Network (nodes, edges, metadata) in gzipped JSON Graph Format v2, e.g. a structural or functional connectome; replaces conmat.
brainlife.name: generic/network

original.desc: Generic network data structure containing nodes and edges with various metadata using JGF v2 format. This datatype will replace the existing "conmat" datatype eventually.

files.desc: Gzipped JSON Graph Format v2 file with one or more networks.

identifying_risks: Individual connectomes can re-identify a participant across datasets.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level connectomes are functionally revealing derivatives (connectome fingerprints).
sharing_cautions: Share participant-level connectomes only under controlled access.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 for group-average or non-human networks.
Tier 4 for a participant's connectome, which can act as a fingerprint.

inputs_of.name: Extract connectivity matrices from network datatype
Extract network statistics and connectivity matrices from network datatype
inputs_of.purpose: export matrices and network statistics to CSV

intended_use: Graph analyses: measures, communities, null models, backbones, reports.
not_suitable_for: Comparing networks built with different parcellations or edge weights without harmonising them.
